name: GEEKOM A9 Mega / Max+
notes: Allocate shared GPU memory via amd-ttm (Linux) or Variable Graphics Memory (Windows).
Prefer LoRA with adamw_torch; avoid fused LoRA kernels that assume NVIDIA Triton paths.
QLoRA needs a ROCm bitsandbytes build matching your ROCm minor version.

name: GEEKOM A9 Max
notes: Start with a 1–3B instruct model for smoke LoRA runs.
Set load_in_4bit only after a matching ROCm bitsandbytes is installed.
On Windows, Unsloth/ROCm community wheels for gfx1150 are an option.

name: Generic RDNA 3.5 (Strix)
torchPackage: torch (pick device-gfx1150 / gfx1151 / gfx1152 for your silicon)
notes: Match the PyTorch wheel extra to your exact gfx target.
Disable lora_*_kernel fused paths in Axolotl-style configs on AMD.
Flash Attention 2 is unavailable on ROCm; Xformers or SDPA is fine.
